headline: Vikram Solar NCLAT Order in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Vikram Solar Limited, a leading Indian solar module manufacturer, has filed an NCLAT order in its ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The company informed the NSE of submission of the NCLAT order copy on 24 June 2026, marking a significant procedural milestone in the insolvency resolution.
detail: Vikram Solar Limited, one of India's largest solar module manufacturers with an annual capacity of over 1.5 GW, has submitted an NCLAT (National Company Law Appellate Tribunal) order in relation to its Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The submission to NSE indicates a formal filing with the stock exchange, likely in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR, 2015. NCLAT intervention typically occurs when parties appeal NCLT orders or when procedural or substantive questions arise during the CIRP. The order's nature-whether it remands the case, affirms the resolution plan, or addresses specific objections-will determine the next steps in the insolvency process.
